messages.subject: predict function with occu model
parts:
Good morning,

I am looking for help with the predict() function.  I am looking to plot detection against a covariate and am getting the following error:

> detect <- read.csv("semireduced.csv", row.names = "SiteCode")

> history <- detect[,1:3]

> julian <- detect[,4:6]

umf.cov <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y = as.matrix(history), obsCovs = list(julian = julian, start = start, time = time, sincerain = sincerain, humidity = humidity, temp = temp, cloud = cloud, gdu = gdu, forest = forest, rain = rain))

> model.julian <- occu(formula=~julian ~1, data = umf.cov)

nd <- data.frame(juliandate=seq(min(detect[,4:6]),max(detect[,4:6]), length=100))

predict(model.julian, newdata = data.frame(nd$juliandate), type = "det")

Error in model.frame.default(X.terms, newdata, na.action = stats::na.pass,  :

object is not a matrix

In addition: Warning message:

'newdata' had 100 rows but variable found had 1 row
